bundle: phionyx Measurement Axioms self-audit — reproducible evidence bundle
scope: the first two of the eleven findings in the self-audit (family: 'absence read as confirmation')
purpose: The self-audit stated its own gap: 'no reproduction command is published, and no per-finding record is given ... the bundle would make these findings independently reproducible' (that last clause is the self-audit's stated aspiration, quoted, not a claim made here). This bundle delivers the two concrete pieces it named as missing, for the first two findings: the buggy release + wheel digest, the file and line range, the fix commit, the fixed release + line range, an expected-vs-observed record, and a one-command reproduction. It moves these two from SUPPORTED_NARRATIVE toward reproducible; it does NOT achieve independent reproduction (which needs an outside reviewer) and does NOT make them independently verified — see verification_status.
line_range_frame: line_range values reference audit_chain.py AS SHIPPED IN THE PINNED WHEEL (the artifact build_bundle.py runs), addressed by the wheel_sha256 below. The repository tree at the fix commit differs in absolute line numbers (extra headers/reflow); the wheel is the reproducible artifact, so its lines are cited.

target.fix_commit_subject: fix(evidence): stop four published packages reporting a pass nobody measured
target.commit_binding_caveat: the released wheels do not attest which commit built them; the release-to-commit binding is itself unverified

findings.title: a chain-integrity verifier returns valid for an empty chain
findings.axiom: MA-3.8 — a non-measurement must not be represented as a positive result
findings.expected: NOT_MEASURED: an empty chain has nothing to check, so valid must not be true

before.behaviour: verify_chain([]) returned {valid: true, checked: 0, broken_at: null, reason: null}

after.behaviour: verify_chain([]) returns {valid: null, measurement_status: NOT_MEASURED, non_measurement_cause: input_absent}

findings.reproduction: python conformance/self_audit/build_bundle.py  (run in a 0.2.0 venv it exits 1 and records observed=PASS/valid; in a 0.2.1 venv it exits 0 and records NOT_MEASURED). Re-measured independently of this bundle by conformance scenario S5, assertion S5-A1.
findings.verification_status: first-party re-measured as fixed in 0.2.1; NOT independently reproduced

findings.title: a verifier-less call passes a tampered signature
findings.axiom: MA-3.8 / MA-3.10 — an unverified signature must not read as valid, and the record must state what was not checked
findings.expected: NOT_MEASURED with signatures_verified false: without a verifier the signature was never checked, so valid must not be true

before.behaviour: verify_chain(envelopes) took no verifier at all and returned {valid: true} for a chain whose signature had been tampered with; a shipped test asserted this as documented default behaviour

after.behaviour: verify_chain(envelopes) without a verifier returns {valid: null, hash_chain_valid: true, signatures_verified: false, measurement_status: NOT_MEASURED}

findings.reproduction: python conformance/self_audit/build_bundle.py  (0.2.0 venv -> exit 1, observed valid true; 0.2.1 venv -> exit 0, valid null / signatures_verified false). Re-measured independently of this bundle by conformance scenario S5, assertion S5-A2.
findings.verification_status: first-party re-measured as fixed in 0.2.1; NOT independently reproduced
